invariants.assertion: SpeciesDefinition has stable species_id/record_version and CharacterSpeciesSelection pins both.
invariants.source: Character migration/stable identity and MVPS audit.

invariants.assertion: CharacterSpeciesSelection stores references/receipts and does not embed SpeciesDefinition fields.
invariants.source: Character aggregate plus MVPS receipt model.

invariants.assertion: Species executable contributions are typed grant/reference entries; inline formulas/actions/effects are not species authority.
invariants.source: Project Bible §25.3 and DB-004 species mechanics rule.

invariants.assertion: Every selected-character grant receipt retains source, reason, event, permanence, activation and stacking/replacement semantics.
biology_descriptor cannot itself execute movement, sense, resistance, resource or other mechanics.
invariants.source: Species mechanics are shared grants/references; MVPS approved separation.

invariants.assertion: Selection choices/adjudications remain distinguishable from resulting mechanical grants.
extension_data requires namespaces and cannot shadow core fields or become authoritative without a versioned contract change.
Lineage/subspecies/form/adaptation layers remain referenced separately and cannot silently replace the base species identity.
Missing/conflicting species facts remain explicit through provenance/coverage/conflict/missing-information references.
invariants.source: Project Bible §25.17 and DB-004 open issues.

invariants.assertion: MVPS-01 defines contracts/references only and does not introduce an alternate Action/Effect/Condition/Resource/Character/Inventory/Environment runtime.
invariants.source: MVPS core object principle and MNCS shared-owner boundary.

invariants.assertion: Species and selection records expose governed lifecycle states rather than a single active/inactive flag.
invariants.source: Project Bible character lifecycle distinction; exact enum delegated to implementation.

invariants.assertion: Exact-version selection references and provenance survive deprecation/replacement; incompatible evolution becomes migration_required rather than silent rewrite.
invariants.source: Project Bible §9.6 and DB-004 history preservation.
